headline: I talk myself out of everything. What's blocking my money?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing MONEY_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The cards were face down, but your hand still found the one with every means available.
Look at his table. Every tool is out and within reach.
You said you talk yourself out of everything and asked what blocks your money. The available tools hold my attention.
And yet the money remains blocked, and your question has turned the cause back on you.
Something has hold of the result without disturbing the tools themselves. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what is holding the result…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You couldn't see the figure, yet you chose the calmest card here.
He hangs upside down by one ankle. His face is calm.
You put your own hesitation beside the money block. This card makes me look at the calm figure and the rope separately.
Still, the result is held, and you have made your own hesitation answer for it.
Something appears right where the result would move beyond hesitation. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
c: You turned the Fool. The picture was hidden, but your hand went to the one in full light.
The sky behind him is gold, without a cloud across it.
You asked what blocks the money after naming your second thoughts. The full light on this card catches me.
But the money remains blocked, though the whole card is in full light.
I keep coming back to something between what is visible and the money. I don't think it began with you.
Now let's look at what's there…
